channel.title: The GW Hatchet - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The GW Hatchet (gwhatchet.com)

item.title: Longtime tourism professor, industry leader dies at 89
item.description: Donald E. Hawkins spent over four decades at GW and received the United Nations World Tourism Organization’s Ulysses Prize for his tourism policy work.

item.title: Op-ed: Due process in the Student Code of Conduct protects us. GW is taking it apart
item.description: Officials’ proposed changes to the Student Code of Conduct — which include removing panels and using broad and discretionary clauses — eviscerate due process, replacing reasonable rules with unchecked administrative power. If you are a GW student, this should terrify you.

item.title: Independent museums bolster Black history preservation as federally funded exhibitions face rollbacks
item.description: As the Trump administration dismantles parts of D.C.’s public tributes to Black history, independent museum leaders said they are continuing their work preserving the city's heritage.

item.title: Crime log: Staff report stolen camera equipment from SMPA building, Smith Center
item.description: Burglary II/Non-Forcible Media and Public Affairs Building Reported – 2/3/2026 Open Case GW staff members reported camera equipment stolen. The GW Police Department has identified one male suspect and believes this burglary to be connected to a similar incident at the Smith Center. – Case open. Burglary II/Non-Forcible Charles E. item.title: Washington Post’s ‘bloodbath’ layoffs hit GW alumni
item.description: Alumni who the Washington Post laid off this week warned massive cuts to the paper's newsroom will hollow out coverage and erode the paper’s credibility.

item.title: Elliott School quietly scrubs online diversity references
item.description: Officials renamed the Elliott Equity Fund to the Elliott Student Opportunities Fund and edited alumni testimonials to remove references to diversity and equity.

item.title: Cedar Hill hospital staffing crisis linked to GW-UHS negotiations over MFA, DC leaders say
item.description: D.C. leaders tracking the hospital’s community impact are closely watching GW-UHS negotiations, viewing their success as key to resolving Cedar Hill’s staffing shortages.

item.title: GW Historians prepare for America 250 commemoration
item.description: On this episode of Getting to the Bottom of It, reporter Maeve Hanscom speaks with GW historians about how they’re commemorating the 250th anniversary of the U.S.’ founding. This podcast was hosted and produced by Lizzie Jensen and Max Porter. Aulx Studio

item.title: Men’s basketball closes out late 75-70 victory over Rhode Island to end four-game skid
item.description: Men's basketball snapped their four game losing streak with a 75-70 victory over Rhode Island on Tuesday.

item.title: Women’s basketball falls 70-63 to Saint Joseph’s, dropping team to 5-8 in A-10 play
item.description: Women’s basketball dropped its second consecutive game on Tuesday afternoon, falling 70-63 to Saint Joseph’s on the road.
